about: Fishing spots outside Misthalin, built where live has them and reached by ::tele until their regions are built (Sam, 9 Nov 2026). Fishing and Cooking 2 step FC1: Catherby's beach (::tele 2850 3430; two Net/Bait, two Cage/Harpoon and three Big Net/Harpoon spots) and Musa Point on Karamja (::tele 2924 3178; three Small Net/Bait and three Cage/Harpoon spots). Types and tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live); the counts and tiles agree with the OSRS Wiki's Fishing spot (cage, harpoon) and (big net, harpoon) pages (read 2026-11-10). Each spot moves between its area's tiles (Fishing.AREAS). Step FC3: Karamja's karambwanji spots in the Holy Lake (::tele 2791 3018) and karambwan spots by the fairy ring DKP (::tele 2899 3118), which stay put. Later steps add the other ::tele fishing spots here.
